scope: Local CI tests and compiler/upgrade checks only. No mainnet signing or broadcast.

localExecutionGas.measurement: gasleft delta around the individual call; excludes funding/setup and transaction intrinsic gas; cold pool/beacon/implementation storage, plus cold market/NFT/mining/BEM for purchase; protocol mocks; not a live BSC estimate

constraints: Model taskId read from the official on-chain reference miner at creation, never passed by frontend. Config ABI unchanged.
Append-only ERC-7201 fields; old flexible pools without initialized model cannot purchase and must use refund paths or a newly configured pool.
Original target priority checked on chain using official listingFor/listingView identity, owner, price cap and miner task/quality. A simulation failure does not mean unavailable.
Read failures fail closed; funding withdrawals and deadline refunds remain available independent of purchase-model and market reads.
Qualified alternative selection does not guarantee the global lowest price or a future yield.
Pull-payment refunds do not call receivers during procurement/finalization; a receiver that always rejects BNB only blocks its own withdrawal.
